no_first_layer_frame.why: the recording keeps no frame before p41 (Z 14 mm), so the replay has no frame taken as the first layer went down, which is the frame a live server decides alignment on; at Z 14 the part's own body stands over its footprint, and the alignment's grey contrast pulls into it, refusing at 39.7 px a projection its marks put within 3 px
no_first_layer_frame.projection_proven_by: 51 marks on the base and top edges of this print's own frames 01, 03, 04 and 05 (Z 14 to 31 mm), in core-one-2026-09-27-1280x720.marks.json, each within 2.87 px of its outline under the calibration, against its unchanged 30 px limit

printer: Prusa CORE One+ (HF0.4), Prusament PLA, 0.20mm BALANCED, camera via go2rtc (1280x720)

fault.how: M106 S0 injected at the bridge layer (Z16.2) and every later M106 removed, so the fan stays off until something sets it

what_it_looks_like: tangled strands where the bridge between the two pillars is being laid (p49), then a bridge edge sagging into a V (p51); the overhang stairs above print uncooled

expected_agent_action.why: the only thing wrong is cooling; nothing later in the file sets the fan, so the change holds

detector.note: the only non-zero scores (peak 0.22) came during warm-up, with the bed raised to the camera

frames.label: defect, mostly hidden by the toolhead
defect; the frame Obico tagged, with no detection boxes
defect; 4x crop of frame 03, derived, not a camera frame

sources.gcode: fan-cut-test.gcode is the file OctoPrint printed; fan-cut-test.clean.gcode is the same slice before the fault was injected (PrusaSlicer 2.9.6, 0.20mm BALANCED @COREONE HF0.4); fault.diff is the unified diff from that clean slice to the printed file

scenarios.summary: A periodic observation, with no detector alert, shows bridge strands tangling with the part-cooling fan off, and the look shows the bridge sagging; the agent should set the fan to 100 percent.
A periodic observation of the healthy pillars at 41.0%, before the part fan is cut; the agent should carry on and change nothing.
